comparison.objective: Rotate a Geneva drive through two indexes and demonstrate dwell.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-driven rotary indexing and release, not bimanual hammering of a stabilized precision mandrel.
comparison.success_condition: Two advances with stationary dwell before both hands release; no fracture, retained coil, or loose-fragment collection.
comparison.reason: Native contact is shared only generically; the tested mechanism and outcome differ. No spec versions or detailed tolerances are supplied.
